segments.en: "Good. Then you're almost Italian."

segments.en: "Yes?"

segments.en: "And a cappuccino at noon?"

segments.it: «Leo, a scuola non provare altre regole.»
segments.en: "Leo, at school don't try any more rules."

segments.it: «Perché?»
segments.en: "Why?"

segments.it: «Perché a scuola gli **sbagli** costano. Al bar no.»
segments.en: "Because at school **mistakes** cost you. At the bar, no."

segments.it: «Va bene. Oggi niente regole.»
segments.en: "All right. No rules today."

segments.it: «Bravo. E domani?»
segments.en: "Good. And tomorrow?"

segments.it: «Domani è un altro giorno.»
segments.en: "Tomorrow is another day."
